name: What compensation can victims of DUI accidents in San Diego seek?

mainEntity.name: What compensation can victims of DUI accidents in San Diego seek?

acceptedAnswer.text: Victims can pursue damages for medical expenses, lost wages, pain and suffering, and wrongful death through civil claims in addition to criminal proceedings against drunk drivers.hillstonelaw+1​
